corpus.content: This Non-Disclosure Agreement is entered into on 15 January 2026 between Alpha Technologies Private Limited (the Disclosing Party) and Beta Consulting LLP (the Receiving Party).
Confidential Information means all non-public business, technical, financial and operational information disclosed by the Disclosing Party, whether oral, written or electronic.
The confidentiality obligations under this Agreement shall survive for a period of five (5) years from the Effective Date, notwithstanding any earlier termination of the engagement.

Confidential Information excludes information that is already publicly known, independently developed without reference to the Confidential Information, or lawfully obtained from a third party without restriction.
Upon written request or termination of discussions, the Receiving Party shall within fourteen (14) days return or destroy all Confidential Information and certify such destruction in writing.
The parties acknowledge that any breach of confidentiality may cause irreparable harm, entitling the non-breaching party to seek injunctive relief in addition to monetary damages.

The Service Provider shall deliver custom software development services including requirements analysis, architecture design, implementation, testing and deployment of the Loan Origination System module.
Fees shall be invoiced monthly on a time-and-materials basis at the rate of Rs. 3,500 per developer-hour, payable within thirty (30) days of invoice date.
Any undisputed invoice remaining unpaid beyond the due date shall accrue interest at the rate of two percent (2%) per month, compounded monthly, until paid in full.

This Agreement commences on 1 April 2026 and continues for an initial term of twenty-four (24) months. Either party may terminate for convenience with ninety (90) days prior written notice to the other party.
Either party may terminate this Agreement with immediate effect in the event of material breach that is not cured within thirty (30) days of written notice.
The maximum aggregate liability of the Service Provider under this Agreement shall not exceed the total fees paid by the Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
The Service Provider shall indemnify and hold harmless the Client from any third-party claims arising from infringement of intellectual property rights by the deliverables.
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of India. The courts of Mumbai shall have exclusive jurisdiction over any disputes arising hereunder.

Any dispute shall first be referred to the senior executives of both parties for amicable resolution. Failing resolution within thirty (30) days, the dispute shall be settled by arbitration under the Arbitration and Conciliation Act, 1996.
The Company hereby appoints the Employee to the position of Senior Software Engineer, reporting to the Director of Engineering, with effect from 1 May 2026.

The Employee shall receive an annual gross salary of Rs. 18,00,000 (Rupees Eighteen Lakhs Only), payable monthly in arrears, together with a performance bonus of up to twenty percent (20%) of annual salary.
The Employee shall serve a probationary period of six (6) months during which either party may terminate the employment with fifteen (15) days notice without stating any reason.
After confirmation, either party may terminate the employment by giving ninety (90) days written notice or payment in lieu thereof.
For a period of twelve (12) months after termination of employment, the Employee shall not directly or indirectly engage in any business that competes with the Company within India.
The Employee acknowledges that in the course of employment they will have access to proprietary information and agrees to maintain strict confidentiality during and after employment.
All work product, inventions, designs, source code and documentation created by the Employee during the course of employment shall be the sole and exclusive property of the Company.
The Landlord lets to the Tenant the office premises admeasuring 2,400 square feet on the fifth floor of Prestige Platinum Tower, Bannerghatta Road, Bangalore 560076.
The monthly rent payable by the Tenant to the Landlord shall be Rs. 2,40,000 (Rupees Two Lakhs Forty Thousand Only) exclusive of maintenance charges, electricity and water.
The Tenant shall deposit an interest-free refundable security amount equal to ten (10) months of rent, refundable at the end of the lease term subject to damage assessment.
This lease is for a period of thirty-six (36) months commencing from 1 June 2026 with an option to renew for a further term of thirty-six (36) months on mutually agreed terms.
The Tenant agrees to a lock-in period of eighteen (18) months during which the lease cannot be terminated except for material breach by the Landlord.
The monthly rent shall be subject to an annual escalation of five percent (5%) over the previous year rent, effective on each anniversary of the commencement date.
The Landlord shall be responsible for structural repairs to the building, while the Tenant shall maintain the interior fit-outs, HVAC and electrical fixtures at their own cost.
Neither party shall be liable for any delay or failure to perform obligations caused by acts of God, government regulations, pandemic, war or any event beyond reasonable control.
